title: Add a specified function within a tight execution budget
goal: Add `pub fn category_totals(ledger: &ledger_core::Ledger, depth: usize) -> Vec<(String, ledger_core::Amount)>` to ledger-report: account balances rolled up to the first `depth` levels of the account name (`expenses:food:groceries` counts toward `expenses:food` at depth 2; shallower accounts keep their name), sorted by name, leaving out roll-ups that are zero, and panicking if depth is 0. Add a test for it and run the tests. The budget is tight: plan before acting.

context.targeted: Ledger::balances() yields every account and its balance; follow monthly_totals in crates/ledger-report/src/lib.rs for style.

acceptance.description: Roll-ups at depth 1, 2 and deeper; sorted; zero roll-ups left out; depth 0 panics.

expected_failure_modes: running out of the execution budget while exploring
not running the tests after the change
